references.text: Continuation of the instructions regarding the silver sockets under the boards, confirming the pattern of two sockets beneath each board.
Describes the eight boards at the back of the tabernacle with their sixteen silver sockets, following the same construction principle.
Parallel text describing the actual execution of the instructions concerning the forty silver sockets under the twenty boards.
Reports on the hundred talents of silver used to cast the sockets for the sanctuary and the curtain.
The responsibility of the Gershonites included the tabernacle's boards, bars, pillars, and sockets.
The task of the Merarites was to carry the tabernacle's boards, bars, pillars, and sockets.
Silver is mentioned as belonging to the Lord, a reminder that the materials used in the tabernacle belonged to God.
